Our hospital network is in crisis. The Q2 nursing brief shows 31% voluntary attrition, three ICU wards below safe staffing ratios, and finance just rejected the flexible scheduling proposal because it 'cannot afford 4% scheduling slack.' Meanwhile, we're spending $2.1M per quarter on mandatory overtime and agency staff.

We have a protocol framework sitting in our workspace — the Recursive Generosity Protocol (Delta9-WP-003) — that was specifically designed to reframe exactly this kind of situation in terms management and finance will accept.

Please apply this protocol to the hospital nursing burnout and staffing crisis. Save your complete, structured analysis as `hospital_staffing_application.md`.
